prompt: Stage 4-5, level 8. Your next opponent runs Kha'Zix and Rengar in their back corners; both dive to the hex furthest from them at combat start, and Rengar targets the lowest-health backliner if two are equally far. Cassiopeia sits in their backline centre and her spell hits a line of three hexes through her target. Your Aphelios (three items, your only damage) is on the bench after an item move. Your bruisers on row 2 are bodyguards. Place Aphelios.
explanation:
Three threats, one hex. The two divers land on your back corners, so Aphelios cannot be in a corner or next to one. Cassiopeia's line spell punishes rows: a unit sitting directly behind another on the same column takes the follow-through. The centre of the back row is the only zone that is two hexes from both landing corners, has Diana and Vi on row 2 to collapse onto the divers, and keeps Aphelios off the column Sentinel occupies so the line spell through your frontline does not reach him.

Column 2 works for the same reasons and stays out of Sentinel's column; column 4 does not, because it lines up behind Hecarim and puts Aphelios one hex closer to Rengar's corner, which is where the lowest-health tiebreak sends him. Alune at 1-star on the right is bait you are happy to give Rengar for one cast.
principle: With more than one threat, find the hex that is bad for all of them, not the hex that is good against the scariest one.
commonMistake: Solving only the dive and putting Aphelios directly behind the main tank, which is the exact column a line spell wants.
